drafts_today.text: Not every Halloween scare is a costume. Waking up to tight, flaky skin after the first cold night? That's your barrier asking for less, not more. Cleanse gently, hydrate on damp skin, seal with a cream. Three steps, done. #SkinBarrier #WinterSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: jack-o'-lantern on the counter, then hands do cleanse, pat serum on damp skin, press in cream. End card: 'The only scary thing is skipping step 3.'

drafts_today.text: The gift for the woman 40+ who says she needs nothing: a calm-skin routine she'll actually use every single day this winter. Three products, one ribbon. DM me and I'll put one together for you. #giftsforher #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: three RIMAN products slide into a gift box one by one, tissue and ribbon go on, end card reads 'For the one who never treats herself.'

drafts_today.text: Clocks fall back this weekend, and the sun still counts. Daily sunscreen is the step most of us skip in November and the one that protects every other product you paid for. Make it the last thing you do before your coffee. #Sunscreen #SkinCare
drafts_today.video_tip: 8 seconds: hand turns a clock back an hour, cut to sunscreen dotted on cheeks and blended, coffee mug lifts into frame. Caption: 'Fall back. Don't skip back.'
